thread:
Liam (Sales): Quick handoff for StellarGrid (mid-market) 40k ARR. Signed for Private (VPC) with PCI-adjacent workflows. Key asks: SSO (SAML preferred), user provisioning (SCIM), and a file ingest agent for data pulls. Customer expects pilot in staging week of 2026-04-20 and GA by 2026-05-20. Main renewal risk: timeline slipping = delayed value capture.

Nora (CS): Assigned. I'll own onboarding board and customer enablement. Can we get the primary contact + any compliance attachments? Also flagging training cadence: 2x onboarding sessions + one dedicated admin workshop.

Liam (Sales): Primary contact: Daniel Cho (dcho@stellargrid.io), Security contact: Mei Zhang (meiz@stellargrid.io). They've attached an internal checklist (link): https://stellargrid.example/compliance-check.

Onboard Bot: Onboarding project created -> https://redwood.example/onboard/1729993333 (autogen items: staging env, SSO setup, SCIM test account, agent install).

Raj (Support): Need their infra team's Slack/email and a rough network diagram for the agent. Also confirm whether agent will be pull (ours connects to their SFTP) or push (their side pushes to us). If pull, we need host, creds, and allowed ports.

Liam (Sales): Infra lead: Carl Rivera <carl@stellargrid.io>. Daniel prefers pull model (we initiate SFTP). He said credentials can be provided to a secure upload bucket once legal signs DPA (they're finalizing).

Evelyn (Eng): I'll scope the ingest agent work. Questions: does the agent need to run in-airgap? Are there constraints on outbound connectivity? If it's pull-only from SFTP, we still need egress to their SFTP endpoint. Estimate: small PoC agent (1 sprint) + security review (3-5 days).

Evelyn (Eng): Quick dev checklist for Daniel/Mei:
```
- Access: SFTP host, port, test account (username/password or key)
- Egress: allowlist our staging egress IPs (I will post)
- SSO: SAML metadata XML (if SAML) or OIDC discovery URL
- SCIM: provisioning endpoint + admin token (test)
- Compliance: any additional cert requirements for agent TLS
```

Nora (CS): Mitigation idea to reduce renewal risk: run a 14-day hosted sandbox for product teams while private infra completes. This gets stakeholders using features and feeds feedback early. Would Sales be ok offering that? :raised_hands:

Liam (Sales): Customer prefers private, but acceptable to start hosted sandbox as long as we document bridge plan and data handling. I'll OK it. Please ensure clear expiry and migration notes.

Nora (CS): Great. Proposed owners & dates:
- Liam: intro to infra & confirm DPA status /02 (owner: Liam)
- Raj: publish network + agent install runbook /06 (owner: Raj)
- Evelyn: scope PoC agent & request test creds /09 (owner: Evelyn)
- Nora: schedule 2 onboarding sessions + admin workshop /12 (owner: Nora)
I'll add these to the onboarding board and create support ticket RG-1145.

Onboard Bot: Support ticket RG-1145 created -> https://redwood.example/ticket/RG-1145.

Raj (Support): Posting staging egress IPs: 35.201.10.12, 35.201.10.13. Runbook link: https://redwood.example/runbooks/agent-install. I'll include cert exchange and firewall checklist.

Evelyn (Eng): Noted. If DPA delays agent credentials, we can demo agent with a synthetic SFTP host internally and collect logs for the customer during sandbox. This reduces blocker risk.

Nora (CS): I'll capture early feedback during the sandbox with a short survey after week 1 and week 2. Action: create feedback form and share with Liam and Daniel.

Liam (Sales): I'll notify Daniel that sandbox + migration plan is approved and share expected timelines. Also flag renewal risk in CRM: "timeline sensitivity - onboarding blockers could push first invoicing milestone."

Evelyn (Eng): One more - if SAML metadata has custom claims, we may need mapping work on our side. Will surface any claim mapping tasks in RG-1145.

Nora (CS): Summarizing owners & next steps in onboarding board now. Will ping @channel when RG-1145 is live and after first enablement session is scheduled.

Liam (Sales): Thanks team  Please escalate any legal or security holds to me ASAP so I can coordinate with the customer.

Nora (CS): Closing thread; will post short digest to the onboarding board with owners and dates. :white_check_mark:
